objective: Add deterministic fuzz, malformed-input, resource-limit, and privacy-boundary tests without adding network or browser access.
acceptanceCriteria: Seeded property-style tests cover unexpected primitive, array, nested, Unicode, duplicate, and extreme manifest values reproducibly.
Input-size, nesting, array-count, malformed JSON, BOM, missing-file, directory, and unreadable-input cases fail safely.
Tests demonstrate that only the selected manifest is read and no source tree, browser profile, environment value, or network resource is inspected.
Error output avoids leaking manifest content, secrets, or absolute personal paths.
No new runtime dependency, telemetry, network call, or browser access is introduced.
The complete suite stays deterministic across Windows and Linux.
stopConditions: A test would require a real credential, personal path, network service, or browser profile.
A fuzz case becomes nondeterministic or unbounded.
Three attempts fail on the same issue.
The exact Ox model is unavailable or rate-limited.
deliverable: Changed public files and compact JSON with seed, case counts, privacy assertions, test results, and blockers.
